# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE5_KEEPER1

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** Parameter optimization — shotgun_scalper stage5 keeper (tp_premium_pct=0.75, stop_premium_pct=-0.35, time_stop_min=12, strike_offset=2, chandelier_arm_pct=0.6, vol_ratio_threshold=1.2)
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper strategy aims to capture small, frequent profits via quick scalping exits. This keeper parameter set adjusts take-profit, stop-loss, time stop, strike selection, volatility filter, and profit-lock arming to improve edge capture on J's winner days while minimizing losses on loser days. The hypothesis is that tighter profit-taking (75% TP) and wider stop (35%) combined with volatility filtering (vol_ratio>1.2) and shorter time stop (12min) will increase win rate and reduce loser-day damage, thereby improving edge_capture.

## Mechanism

**Entry trigger:** Fires when volume ratio (current 5m bar volume / 20-bar average volume) exceeds 1.2, indicating heightened participation. Strike selection uses `strike_offset=2` (likely 2 strikes OTM for puts/ITM for calls based on signal direction).  
**Exit logic:**  
- Take profit at +75% of entry premium (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)  
- Stop loss at -35% of entry premium (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`)  
- Hard time exit after 12 minutes if neither TP nor SL hit (`time_stop_min=12`)  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +60% of entry premium (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`) and trails 15% from high-water mark (standard v15 chandelier settings)  
- All exits subject to chart-stop primary invalidation (structure-based) per doctrine C2.
